# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 29 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 29 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_029_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 3 — Truth

**1** He continued: "Love the truth. Let only truth come out of your mouth — so that the spirit God placed inside you to live in this body will be recognized as true by everyone around you, and the Lord who lives in you will be honored. Because the Lord himself is completely true — there is no deception in him anywhere. **2** Those who lie are disowning the Lord and cheating him — they're failing to return what was entrusted to them. God gave them a spirit free of all deception; if they hand it back corrupted with lies, they've defiled and dishonored what the true Lord deposited in them. **3** But those who live in truth — they please God and they live to God." **4** "What happens to those who falsify things and lie?" "They have no life with God — unless they repent and stop lying and start living in truth again. For those who repent of their lying are made holy. Blessed are all the righteous who keep the Lord's commandments."

---

*PNEUMA note: The "deposit" concept transforms lying into something worse than mere dishonesty — it is the defilement of a sacred trust. The Spirit within is not our own; it is on loan from a truthful God and must be returned truthfully.*
